_about: Single source of truth for the TenSura World Database. engine/build_db.py reads this file, resolves the name references, and writes tensura.db, sql/seed.sql, and the bi-exports CSVs. Facts are drawn from the Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken light novels and the fan wiki. EP figures are wiki-cited existence values and are approximate late-story peaks.

races.name: Slime
races.notes: The weakest common monster; the form Rimuru is reborn into.

races.name: Demon Slime
races.notes: The apex of slime evolution, reached by awakening as a True Demon Lord.

races.name: Goblin
races.notes: Small forest humanoids, weak on their own.

races.name: Hobgoblin
races.notes: The evolved form of goblins after being named by a powerful monster.

races.name: Ogre
races.notes: Strong horned humanoids; the surviving ogre village that joined Rimuru.

races.name: Kijin
races.notes: Ogres evolved into a refined oni-like race after Rimuru named them.

races.name: Oni
races.notes: The higher oni forms the kijin reach at the Harvest Festival.

races.name: Direwolf
races.notes: Pack-hunting wolves of the Great Jura Forest.

races.name: Tempest Wolf
races.notes: Direwolves evolved under Veldora's influence and Rimuru's naming.

races.name: Tempest Star Wolf
races.notes: The leader variant of the star wolf line; Ranga's form.

races.name: Lizardman
races.notes: Marsh-dwelling reptilian humanoids.

races.name: Dragonewt
races.notes: Lizardmen who reawaken their dragon roots, often through naming.

races.name: Orc
races.notes: Pig-like humanoids that swarm in famine.

races.name: High Orc
races.notes: The evolved orc form that serves Tempest under Geld.

races.name: Orc Disaster
races.notes: A Demon Lord seed; the evolution of an Orc Lord that devours its own kind.

races.name: Dwarf
races.notes: Master craftsmen of the Armed Nation of Dwargon.

races.name: Human
races.notes: The dominant people of the western nations.

races.name: Otherworlder
races.notes: People summoned or reincarnated from another world, often carrying unique skills.

races.name: Elf
races.notes: Long-lived people of the Sorcerous Dynasty of Sarion.

races.name: High Elf
races.notes: The elder elven line; the Empress Elmesia's kind.

races.name: Dryad
races.notes: Tree spirits that guard the Great Jura Forest.

races.name: Pixie
races.notes: Tiny fairy spirits; Ramiris's race.

races.name: Demon
races.notes: Beings from the spirit world, ranging from lesser to arch demons.

races.name: Primordial Demon
races.notes: The seven oldest demons, each known by a colour rather than a name.

races.name: Majin
races.notes: Demon-kin; the clown troupe and several schemers belong here.

races.name: Dragonoid
races.notes: The rare children of a True Dragon; Milim's race.

races.name: True Dragon
races.notes: The four near-immortal apex dragons of the world.

races.name: Vampire
races.notes: Blood-drinking nobles; the Valentine line of Lubelius.

races.name: Wight
races.notes: Powerful undead sorcerers; the Wight King guards the labyrinth.

races.name: Insectar
races.notes: Insect-kin of the labyrinth, led by the Insect Kaiser.

races.name: Beastfolk
races.notes: Animal-featured warriors of the Beast Kingdom of Eurazania.

races.name: Winged
races.notes: Sky-dwelling harpy people; Frey's race.

races.name: Giant
races.notes: Titanic beings; Dagruel's kind.

races.name: Seraph
races.notes: Angelic beings tied to the world's guardian system; Dino's true nature.

races.name: Mystic Fox
races.notes: Nine-tailed mystic foxes; Kumara is a young Ninehead of this line.

races.name: Wicked Oni
races.notes: The higher oni form Shion reached when she was revived through daemons.

races.name: Arch Doll
races.notes: A daemon bound into a crafted golem body, as with Beretta.

races.name: Metal Daemon
races.notes: A daemon of living metal; the form Gadra took after his reincarnation.

arcs.name: Reincarnation in the Jura Forest
arcs.summary: A man reborn as a slime befriends the sealed dragon Veldora, then names the goblins and direwolves and forms the first forest alliance.

arcs.name: The Dwarven Kingdom
arcs.summary: Rimuru visits the Armed Nation of Dwargon, gains the smith Kaijin, and draws the eye of King Gazel.

arcs.name: War of the Orc Disaster
arcs.summary: The Orc Lord ravages the forest, the ogre survivors are named into kijin, and the Great Jura Forest alliance is forged.

arcs.name: Founding of the Nation
arcs.summary: The Jura Tempest Federation is founded, holds its opening festival, and the demon lords begin to take notice.

arcs.name: The Teacher and the Otherworlders
arcs.summary: Rimuru teaches the summoned children in Ingracia, learns Shizu's past, and first crosses the holy knight Hinata.

arcs.name: Clayman's Web
arcs.summary: Milim, the monster Charybdis, and the schemer Clayman pull the demon lords toward open conflict.

arcs.name: The Falmuth Invasion
arcs.summary: Falmuth and Hinata strike Tempest while Rimuru is away, and many of its people are killed.

arcs.name: The Harvest Festival
arcs.summary: Rimuru awakens as a True Demon Lord, revives the fallen, and the whole of Tempest evolves.

arcs.name: Walpurgis, the Demon Lords' Banquet
arcs.summary: Clayman is defeated at the demon lords' banquet and the eight-seat Octagram is formed.

arcs.name: Hinata and the Holy Church
arcs.summary: The clash and reconciliation with the Holy Empire of Lubelius, and the truth of the vampire demon lord Luminous.

arcs.name: The Founding Festival and the Labyrinth
arcs.summary: Tempest opens to the world with a festival and tournament, and Ramiris's labyrinth is raised under the city.

arcs.name: War with the Eastern Empire
arcs.summary: The vast Eastern Empire invades the forest and is broken by Tempest's officers and the freed Veldora.

skills.name: Raphael, Lord of Wisdom
skills.notes: Evolved from Great Sage; runs Rimuru's analysis, calculation, and skill control.

skills.name: Beelzebuth, Lord of Gluttony
skills.notes: Evolved from Gluttony; devours and stores targets and their abilities.

skills.name: Uriel, Lord of Vows
skills.notes: Barrier and spatial control bound to promises Rimuru makes.

skills.name: Azathoth, Void God
skills.notes: Rimuru's later fused ultimate governing void and space.

skills.name: Amaterasu, Lord of the Blazing Sun
skills.notes: Benimaru's flame ultimate.

skills.name: Tsukuyomi, Lord of Moon Shadow
skills.notes: Souei's shadow and space ultimate.

skills.name: Susanoo, Lord of Tyranny
skills.notes: Shion's ultimate, evolved from her unique skill Cook.

skills.name: Azazel, Lord of Temptation
skills.notes: Diablo's ultimate, formed from Tempter and Seeker.

skills.name: Mammon, Lord of Greed
skills.notes: Yuuki's sin-series ultimate.

skills.name: Metatron, Lord of Purity
skills.notes: Leon Cromwell's light ultimate.

skills.name: Faust, Lord of Investigation
skills.notes: Veldora's analysis ultimate, learned partly from Rimuru.

skills.name: Veldora, Lord of Storms
skills.notes: Rimuru's ultimate, gained by absorbing the remains of Veldora inside Beelzebuth.

skills.name: Michael, Lord of Justice
skills.notes: The controlling angel ultimate held by Emperor Rudra.

skills.name: Lucifer, Lord of Pride
skills.notes: Guy Crimson's sin-series ultimate.

skills.name: Satanael, Lord of Wrath
skills.notes: Milim's sin-series ultimate, powering her magicule breeder reactor.

skills.name: Mephisto, Lord of Fantasy
skills.notes: Zegion's illusion and space ultimate.

skills.name: Fortuna
skills.notes: Hinata's precognition ultimate, an evolution of Mathematician.

skills.name: Predator
skills.notes: Rimuru's starting skill; consumes and copies targets.

skills.name: Great Sage
skills.notes: Rimuru's starting analysis skill; evolves into Raphael.

skills.name: Gluttony
skills.notes: The higher predation skill that evolves into Beelzebuth.

skills.name: Generalissimo
skills.notes: Benimaru's command skill for directing troops.

skills.name: Analyst
skills.notes: Shuna's skill for reading and understanding anything she studies.

skills.name: Manufacturer
skills.notes: Shuna's crafting and production skill.

skills.name: Cook
skills.notes: Shion's skill that makes any imagined result come out right.

skills.name: Tempter
skills.notes: Diablo's temptation skill; folds into Azazel.

skills.name: Seeker
skills.notes: Diablo's investigation skill; folds into Azazel.

skills.name: Mathematician
skills.notes: Hinata's calculation skill that predicts an opponent's moves.

skills.name: Creator
skills.notes: Yuuki's unique skill that fabricates other skills and abilities.

skills.name: Manipulator
skills.notes: Clayman's unique skill for controlling people and running a spy network.

skills.name: Chosen One
skills.notes: Masayuki's luck skill that bends situations in his favour.

skills.name: Infinite Regeneration
skills.notes: Rimuru's slime-body regeneration.

skills.name: Universal Shapeshift
skills.notes: Rimuru's ability to mimic any form he has predated.

skills.name: Universal Perception
skills.notes: Full-space sensing shared by several apex beings.

skills.name: Black Lightning
skills.notes: Ranga's signature storm attack.

skills.name: Shadow Motion
skills.notes: Souei's movement through shadows.

skills.name: Drago Nova
skills.notes: Milim's devastating dragon energy blast.

skills.name: Vortex Spear
skills.notes: Gabiru's spinning water attack.

skills.name: Flame Manipulation
skills.notes: The flame power Shizu wielded while hosting the spirit Ifrit.

skills.name: Martial Master
skills.notes: Hakurou's peerless swordsmanship.

skills.name: Shadow Striker
skills.notes: Souei's covert-operations unique skill.

factions.name: Jura Tempest Federation Leadership
factions.notes: The ministers and officers who run Rimuru's nation.

factions.name: Twelve Guardian Lords
factions.notes: Tempest's circle of strongest guardians; the roster grew over time.

factions.name: Octagram
factions.notes: The eight-seat demon lord council formed after Walpurgis.

factions.name: Ten Great Demon Lords
factions.notes: The older ten-seat demon lord order that preceded the Octagram.

factions.name: Primordial Demons
factions.notes: The seven oldest demons, each named for a colour.

factions.name: Three Devil Girls
factions.notes: Testarossa, Ultima, and Carrera, who serve Rimuru as diplomats and executives.

factions.name: Holy Knights of Lubelius
factions.notes: The crusaders of the Luminism faith, led by Hinata.

factions.name: Free Guild
factions.notes: The independent adventurers' guild spanning the western nations.

factions.name: Moderate Harlequin Alliance
factions.notes: The clown troupe of schemers behind much of the early conflict.

factions.name: Imperial Guardians
factions.notes: The elite officers of the Eastern Empire.

factions.name: Three Beastketeers
factions.notes: The three strongest beast warriors of Eurazania.

nations.name: Jura Tempest Federation
nations.notes: The monster nation Rimuru builds in the Great Jura Forest.

nations.name: Armed Nation of Dwargon
nations.notes: The dwarven kingdom of craftsmen ruled by the Hero King Gazel.

nations.name: Kingdom of Blumund
nations.notes: A small human kingdom bordering the forest; Rimuru's first foreign contact.

nations.name: Kingdom of Falmuth
nations.notes: A human kingdom that invaded Tempest and lost; later re-founded as the Kingdom of Farmenas under King Youm.

nations.name: Sorcerous Dynasty of Sarion
nations.notes: A union of elven states around the Divine Tree, ruled by Empress Elmesia.

nations.name: Holy Empire of Lubelius
nations.notes: The theocracy of the Luminism faith, secretly ruled by the vampire demon lord Luminous.

nations.name: Beast Kingdom of Eurazania
nations.notes: The beastfolk nation of the former demon lord Carrion.

nations.name: Nasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Empire
nations.notes: The vast eastern empire of the eternal emperor Rudra, guarded by the Scorch Dragon.

nations.name: Kingdom of Englassia
nations.notes: A western human kingdom, also rendered Ingracia, home to the Free Guild headquarters and Yuuki's school.

characters.name: Rimuru Tempest
characters.notes: A man reincarnated as a slime who builds a monster nation and becomes one of the strongest beings alive.

demon_lord.title: Demon Lord Rimuru
demon_lord.notes: Recognised as a True Demon Lord after the Harvest Festival.

characters.name: Veldora Tempest
characters.role_title: Guardian and sworn friend of Rimuru
characters.notes: One of the four True Dragons, sealed for centuries until Rimuru freed him.

true_dragon.notes: The youngest True Dragon; takes the family name Tempest.

characters.name: Benimaru
characters.notes: Leader of the ogre survivors, evolved into a kijin and later a flame oni.

skills.skill: Amaterasu, Lord of the Blazing Sun

characters.name: Shuna
characters.notes: Benimaru's sister, a gentle priestess and skilled craftsperson.

characters.name: Shion
characters.notes: Rimuru's fierce secretary, killed in the Falmuth attack and revived at the Harvest Festival.

characters.name: Souei
characters.notes: A quiet, deadly kijin who runs Tempest's intelligence network.

characters.name: Hakurou
characters.notes: The elderly master swordsman of the kijin, teacher to Tempest's fighters.

characters.name: Kurobe
characters.notes: The kijin smith who forges Tempest's finest weapons.

characters.name: Rigurd
characters.notes: The first goblin chief Rimuru named; now the head of Tempest's civil government.

characters.name: Gobta
characters.notes: A goofy but oddly gifted goblin who leads the wolf-riding cavalry.

characters.name: Ranga
characters.notes: The direwolf pup who grew into Rimuru's loyal storm wolf, living in his shadow.

characters.name: Gabiru
characters.role_title: Head of the flying corps and research
characters.notes: A proud lizardman leader who becomes a dragonewt and a devoted Tempest officer.

characters.name: Souka
characters.notes: Gabiru's sister, a disciplined agent serving under Souei.

characters.name: Geld
characters.notes: Named after the fallen Orc Disaster, he leads the orcs who build and defend Tempest.

characters.name: Diablo
characters.notes: One of the seven primordial demons, who begs to serve Rimuru after being summoned.

characters.name: Testarossa
characters.notes: The White Primordial, who serves Rimuru as a fearsome diplomat.

characters.name: Ultima
characters.notes: The Purple Primordial, cruel in battle and loyal to Rimuru.

characters.name: Carrera
characters.notes: The Yellow Primordial, who loves a good fight and serves Rimuru.

characters.name: Ramiris
characters.notes: An ancient, tiny fairy demon lord who moves her labyrinth beneath Tempest.

demon_lord.title: Labyrinth
demon_lord.notes: One of the oldest demon lords despite her small stature.

characters.name: Beretta
characters.notes: A demon Rimuru bound into a golem body to protect Ramiris.

characters.name: Treyni
characters.role_title: Dryad of the Great Jura Forest
characters.notes: The elegant tree spirit who watches over the forest and favours Rimuru.

characters.name: Adalmann
characters.notes: A devout undead sorcerer who guards a floor of the labyrinth.

characters.name: Zegion
characters.notes: A once-lowly insect who trained under Veldora into one of Tempest's strongest.

characters.name: Kumara
characters.notes: A young nine-tailed spirit beast who guards the labyrinth.

characters.name: Gadra
characters.notes: A former court mage of the Eastern Empire, reincarnated into a metal daemon, who defects to Tempest and studies its labyrinth.

characters.name: Kaijin
characters.notes: A dwarven smith exiled from Dwargon who becomes the backbone of Tempest's industry.

characters.name: Shizue Izawa
characters.notes: A summoned hero who hosted the flame spirit Ifrit; her memory shapes Rimuru's human form.

characters.name: Veldanava
characters.notes: The firstborn True Dragon who shaped the world and fathered Milim; long dead by the main story.

true_dragon.notes: The strongest of the True Dragons; gave up his power to create the world.

characters.name: Velzard
characters.notes: The second True Dragon, who keeps company with the demon lord Guy in the frozen north.

true_dragon.notes: Also called the Ice Dragon; sister of Veldora and Velgrynd.

characters.name: Velgrynd
characters.nation: Nasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Empire
characters.notes: The third True Dragon, who serves Emperor Rudra as his marshal and guardian.

true_dragon.notes: Devoted to Rudra; wields scorching flame magic.

characters.name: Milim Nava
characters.role_title: One of the oldest Demon Lords
characters.notes: The daughter of Veldanava and among the very strongest demon lords, who becomes Rimuru's close friend.

demon_lord.title: Destroyer
demon_lord.notes: Nicknamed the Dragon Princess; one of the oldest demon lords.

characters.name: Guy Crimson
characters.notes: The Red Primordial and the eldest demon lord, who holds his throne in the frozen north.

demon_lord.title: Mediator
demon_lord.notes: The first primordial demon; acts on the late Veldanava's behalf.

characters.name: Luminous Valentine
characters.role_title: Demon Lord and true ruler of Lubelius
characters.notes: The vampire demon lord who is secretly worshipped as the god of the Luminism faith.

demon_lord.title: Divine Enemy
demon_lord.notes: Rules Lubelius from the shadows as its living god.

characters.name: Leon Cromwell
characters.notes: A summoned swordsman who became a demon lord and once summoned Shizu; rules a golden country.

demon_lord.title: Platinum Saber
demon_lord.notes: Searches for a summoned girl he cares for.

characters.name: Dino
characters.notes: A demon lord who lounges around Tempest's labyrinth, secretly an agent of the world's angelic side.

demon_lord.title: Sleeping Ruler
demon_lord.notes: One of the fallen who serves the Cardinal World; poses as a lazy demon lord.

characters.name: Dagruel
characters.notes: A colossal, taciturn demon lord who guards his own domain.

demon_lord.title: Wicked God
demon_lord.notes: Guards a sealed region and rarely involves himself in politics.

characters.name: Carrion
characters.notes: The lion-like former demon lord who rules the beastfolk and allies with Rimuru and Milim.

demon_lord.title: Beast Master
demon_lord.notes: Stepped down from the demon lord seats and became a vassal of Milim.

characters.name: Albis
characters.notes: A serpent-attributed beastfolk general of Eurazania.

characters.name: Suphia
characters.notes: A beastfolk general of Eurazania who serves Carrion.

characters.name: Grucius
characters.notes: A wolf-attributed lycanthrope of Eurazania, part of Carrion's delegation to Tempest.

characters.name: Frey
characters.role_title: Former Demon Lord of the sky
characters.notes: A harpy demon lord who gives up her seat and joins Milim as a trusted aide.

demon_lord.title: Sky Queen
demon_lord.notes: Became one of Milim's subordinates after Walpurgis.

characters.name: Clayman
characters.notes: A cruel demon lord who manipulates others from behind the scenes; killed by Rimuru at Walpurgis.

demon_lord.title: Marionette Master
demon_lord.notes: Faked greater strength through puppets; defeated at the demon lords' banquet.

characters.name: Kagali
characters.role_title: Leader of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance
characters.notes: The reborn former demon lord Kazaream, who leads the clown troupe of schemers.

characters.name: Laplace
characters.notes: A cheerful, dangerous clown who works his own agenda within the troupe.

characters.name: Tear
characters.notes: A childlike clown of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance.

characters.name: Footman
characters.notes: A rotund, violent clown of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance.

characters.name: Gazel Dwargo
characters.notes: The warrior king of the dwarves, a former hero who becomes one of Rimuru's steadiest allies.

characters.name: Elmesia El Ru Sarion
characters.notes: The long-lived, playful empress of the elven dynasty, who befriends Rimuru.

characters.name: Hinata Sakaguchi
characters.notes: The peerless holy knight who first hunts Rimuru, then becomes a wary ally.

characters.name: Chloe Aubert
characters.notes: A summoned child taught by Rimuru who is bound to a great destiny across time.

characters.name: Masayuki
characters.notes: A summoned youth whose luck skill makes the world treat him as a legendary hero.

characters.name: Yuuki Kagurazaka
characters.notes: The affable head of the Free Guild who hides a long-running scheme against the world's order.

characters.name: Fuze
characters.notes: The shrewd Blumund guild master who becomes an early friend to Tempest.

characters.name: Youm
characters.notes: A mercenary Rimuru backs to become the reform king of Falmuth after its invasion fails.

characters.name: Razen
characters.notes: Falmuth's court sorcerer, captured after the failed invasion; in the novels he survives and later serves the reformed kingdom.

characters.name: Rudra Nam Ul Nasca
characters.nation: Nasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Empire
characters.notes: The undying emperor who has ruled the East for two thousand years through repeated lives.

characters.name: Kondo Tatsuya
characters.nation: Nasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Empire
characters.role_title: Head of the Imperial Intelligence Bureau
characters.notes: A cold, gun-wielding officer who serves as the Empire's chief of military staff.

characters.name: Damrada
characters.nation: Nasca Namrium Ulmeria United Eastern Empire
characters.notes: A powerful merchant tied to the Empire's covert operations.

characters.name: Phobio
characters.notes: A black-leopard lycanthrope of Eurazania; the Charybdis incident grew out of Milim goading him.
